profile.tagline: Backend engineer focused on architecture and operating real production systems — trade-offs, not just frameworks.
about.first: I'm a backend and DevOps engineer based in Bogotá, Colombia, looking for a role at a company abroad — remote or with relocation. I lead backend development and infrastructure at BO-TECH, and I'm a co-owner at Páramo Programing, where we build custom software for clients across different sectors.
about.second: I'm not just someone who writes endpoints: I've led a small, multidisciplinary team, made architecture and infrastructure decisions in production, and turned client requirements into complete builds. I also have a background in innovation and data analysis that helps me gather requirements clearly — though my focus stays on backend and DevOps.
